input.quote: Customer will not assign this Agreement or any of its rights hereunder without the prior written consent of IBM, such consent not to be unreasonably withheld. Notwithstanding the foregoing, Customer may assign this Agreement to a successor organization by merger, consolidation or acquisition.
input.rationale: Section 14.10 restricts only Customer assignment. The M&A carve-out is partial: it omits assignment to affiliates and to a purchaser of substantially all assets, and it is unclear whether the carve-out dispenses with IBM's consent. The clause imposes no reciprocal restriction on IBM, so IBM could freely assign, including to a Customer competitor. No change-of-control termination right exists for IBM (§3.3 is breach-only), so no deletion is needed there. Redline adds the affiliate/asset-sale carve-out without consent and a reciprocal, reasonableness-qualified consent requirement on IBM with a competitor prohibition; fallback of mutual successor assignment on notice offered in the comment.

ops.oldText: Customer will not assign this Agreement or any of its rights hereunder without the prior written consent of IBM, such consent not to be unreasonably withheld. Notwithstanding the foregoing, Customer may assign this Agreement to a successor organization by merger, consolidation or acquisition.
ops.newText: Customer will not assign this Agreement or any of its rights hereunder without the prior written consent of IBM, such consent not to be unreasonably withheld. Notwithstanding the foregoing, Customer may assign this Agreement without IBM's consent to an affiliate or to a successor organization by merger, consolidation, acquisition or sale of substantially all of its assets. IBM will not assign this Agreement or any of its rights hereunder without Customer's prior written consent, such consent not to be unreasonably withheld, and in no event to a competitor of Customer.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] We added our customary right to assign without consent to an affiliate or to a successor by merger, acquisition or sale of substantially all assets, and made the consent restriction reciprocal so IBM cannot assign to a Customer competitor. If helpful, we can accept a mutual right to assign to successors on written notice, with consent for other assignments not unreasonably withheld.
proposal.summary: Add affiliate/asset-sale carve-out for Customer assignment and reciprocal consent restriction on IBM assignment.
